provenance: Codex subagent review of immutable prepared inputs; findings checked against source, separate from deterministic validation.
rationale: ObjectId is a structure wrapping index : Nat. obj(n) is the mathematical spelling of its constructor; index(obj(n))=n is the structure projection, so identities are tagged rather than bare naturals. Notation and premises are supplied by the examined units given.classes, given.collections, given.programs, given.syntax.
limitations: This compares the authored statement/definition/example with the selected formalization. It does not independently recheck Lean proof tactics or attest to a compiler run.
